messages:
Jamie: FYI Raj G submitted resignation last night; last day 2026-04-03 EOD. Can we run through offboard tasks? COBRA dates, access removal, laptop shipping. Late notice :grimacing:
Marta: On it. I'll send the COBRA packet today and confirm benefits end date. @Jamie do we owe any unused bonus/PTO payout?
Aditya: I can own the exit interview — can we do Mon 2026-03-29 10:30am PT? If that doesn't work, suggest alternatives.
Alex: IT here. Heads-up on a few technical items: need to revoke his IPs from prod whitelist, remove VPN credentials, and rotate any shared keys he had. Inventory shows company laptop S/N ABC123 assigned.
Emily (Logistics): I can book a prepaid return label and schedule pickup to his home. Will wait for People Ops to confirm pickup address and timing. :truck: :package:
Jamie: Yes, home pickup is fine. Marta please include the COBRA enrollment link and final pay date in outreach. @it-bot can you queue the deprovision job but hold email GDrive until People Ops confirms retention?
it-bot: it-bot: deprovision job queued for 2026-04-04 01:00 UTC. Actions planned: revoke VPN, disable SSO, remove from prod IP whitelist. Will NOT disable email or Drive until People Ops toggles retention.
Alex: Example of the internal command we'll run (ops-only):
```
./revoke_access --user raj.g --services vpn,ssh,aws --ip-whitelist remove 1.2.3.4
```
We'll run it post-payroll cutoff on the scheduled window.
Marta: COBRA/benefits note: benefits coverage ends 2026-04-03; COBRA notice needs to go out within 7 days. I'll email the enrollment packet to Raj today and CC benefits@redwood. Also proposing a 90-day email retention hold unless Legal requests otherwise.
Aditya: Exit interview scheduled Mon 3/29 10:30am PT — invite sent to Raj and his manager. I'll capture action items and outstanding PRs for handoff.
Jamie: One more ask — please do NOT remove GitHub org access until 2026-04-03 23:00 PT; if possible flip to read-only before full removal. @Alex can you confirm that flow?
Alex: Confirmed. We'll set org membership to read-only at 2026-04-03 23:00 PT and complete full removal at 2026-04-04 01:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
Marta: I'll follow up on final payroll, 401(k) deferral questions, and send the shipping instructions to Raj. Shared checklist for visibility: https://wiki.redwood/internal/offboard-checklist
Jamie: :white_check_mark: Thanks everyone. If any blockers surface, ping me directly and we can escalate.
